gloss: wealth gap; gap between rich and poor

definitions.gloss: wealth gap; disparity between rich and poor
definitions.explanation: The difference in economic status between wealthy and poor members of a society.

examples.japanese: {貧富|ひんぷ}の{差|さ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっている→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
⟦{教育|きょういく}→教育：01313_kyouiku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{貧富|ひんぷ}の{差|さ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{縮|ちぢ}める→縮める：04245_chijimeru⟧⟦{鍵|かぎ}→鍵：02189_kagi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Education is the key to narrowing the wealth gap.

examples.japanese: {貧富|ひんぷ}の{差|さ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{社会的|しゃかいてき}→社会的：04791_shakaiteki⟧な⟦{不安定|ふあんてい}→不安定：11318_fuantei⟧さ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ま}す→増す：02422_masu⟧⟦{傾向|けいこう}→傾向：02695_keikou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: In countries with severe wealth gaps, social instability tends to increase.

notes:
{貧富|ひんぷ} (poverty and wealth) + ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ (possessive) + ⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧ (difference, gap). A set phrase used in news, politics, and social commentary to discuss economic inequality.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {貧富|ひんぷ}の{差|さ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がる→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧ — the wealth gap widens
- {貧富|ひんぷ}の{差|さ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{縮|ちぢ}める→縮める：04245_chijimeru⟧ — narrow the wealth gap
- {貧富|ひんぷ}の{差|さ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧ — the wealth gap is severe
- {貧富|ひんぷ}の{差|さ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧なくす — eliminate the wealth gap

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{格差|かくさ}→格差：04839_kakusa⟧ — disparity; gap — broader term covering any kind of gap (income, education, regional)
- {経済格差|けいざいかくさ} — economic disparity — more formal and precise
- {所得格差|しょとくかくさ} — income gap — focuses specifically on income rather than overall wealth
